server.name: waqarakhtar-portfolio
server.title: Waqar Akhtar — Portfolio
server.description: Read-only tools for exploring Waqar Akhtar's personal portfolio: bio, skills, experience timeline, projects, education, resume, and contact information. All tools are plain HTTPS GET requests returning text/HTML or text/markdown; no authentication required.
server.instructions: Use these tools to answer questions about who Waqar Akhtar is, what he has built, his experience and education, and how to contact him. Start with get_site_overview for a plain-language summary (llms.txt), then fetch specific pages as needed.

tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Fetch the llms.txt overview: a plain-language description of Waqar Akhtar, the site's contents, and links to all key pages. Best starting point for orienting on the site.

tools.name: get_home_page
tools.description: Fetch the home page: hero introduction, about summary, skills badges, experience timeline, education, and contact section.

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Fetch the full projects page listing every project with descriptions, tech stacks, and links to live demos and source code.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch one specific project's page from the projects page. Provide the project title exactly as one of: EchoME X, Restaurant Insights Analytics, PrepPal AI, Hydro Heroes, Azinhack 2025, USAR Samvad, KERB - Preserve the Curve, SIF-Trace, Threadly, LapLogic.

title.description: Exact project title, e.g. "EchoME X" or "LapLogic"

tools.name: get_resume
tools.description: Download Waqar Akhtar's resume as a PDF document.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Fetch the Get in Touch section: email address and links to GitHub, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and the Dev.to blog. Also available directly via the mailto link in the response.

resources.name: Projects
resources.description: All projects with details and links
